scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks: Assistance on Fixed Capital Investment
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Industries Association or any enterprise registered under the Societies Act, Partnership Act, Trust Act, Companies Act, or an SPV constituted for setting up an Industrial Park
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of up to ₹30 crore for eligible fixed capital investment (25% in general areas, 50% in Vanbandhu Talukas) and up to ₹20 crore for constructing worker hostels or dormitories.
